zh.title: 回收站
zh.hint: 会话保留 30 天；恢复后可继续会话。
zh.clearConfirm: 永久删除回收站中的 {n} 个会话？删除后无法恢复。
zh.clearDeferred: 部分会话暂时无法清理，已保留并等待重试。
zh.changed: 回收站内容已变化，请重新确认后清空。
zh.countdown: 剩余 {days} 天 {clock} 永久删除
zh.permanentConfirm: 永久删除会话“{title}”？删除后无法恢复。
zh.deleteDeferred: 该会话暂时无法安全删除，已保留并等待重试。
zh.readOnly: 回收站会话仅供查看和引用，恢复后才能继续会话。
zh.referenceHint: 在其他会话中使用 @ 选择此会话，或复制 Session ID 进行引用。
zh.error: 回收站操作未完成，请检查连接后重试。
zh.stopConfirm: 该会话仍有进行中或待处理的工作，移入回收站会停止这些工作。继续删除？

en.title: Recycle Bin
en.hint: Conversations are kept for 30 days. Restore one to continue chatting.
en.clearConfirm: Permanently delete {n} conversations from the Recycle Bin? This cannot be undone.
en.clearDeferred: Some conversations could not be cleared yet. They were retained for a later retry.
en.changed: The Recycle Bin has changed. Review it and confirm again.
en.choose: Select a conversation on the left
en.permanentConfirm: Permanently delete “{title}”? This cannot be undone.
en.deleteDeferred: This conversation could not be safely deleted yet. It was retained for a later retry.
en.readOnly: This conversation is read-only. Restore it to continue chatting.
en.referenceHint: Use @ in another conversation to reference this one, or copy its Session ID.
en.error: The Recycle Bin operation failed. Check the connection and retry.
en.stopConfirm: This conversation has work in progress or awaiting input. Moving it to the Recycle Bin will stop that work. Delete it?
